wom25 wrote: hi there J

a quick question, in this picture we see a RBD, RED BOX is now a Flag Limit, the question is that why this Box or FL broken or not respected? why EJ went that much high again?

Yes there is a LTF FL inside the lower edge of the red box.

Price did only produce a small bounce but nothing more (no PA).

As to why price wanted higher, not sure how to answer this, I guess to cause more pain and fill orders...

I'm posting here my initial thinking about EJ, maybe this helps:

This caught my attention, at first it was just a LTFscalp

Then price did bounce (took enough to cover for the SL)

Then the second higher FL was engulfed and I exited on a RT to more or less BE

Then I started to look for HTF levels as it was clear that price was attracted to some good tg

Where that high was coming down

So with the approach in mind there were 2 FLs/FTRs at 2 QM levels

Now that the target for the LTF eng was hit, price could still go up for the higher levels, in that case I have the stop covered.

Other than that I just wait and see if price is ready to follow the HTF eng now.

About the target, it depends on PA, price could all the way down to origin, but there's a SR flip in the way, so I'll watch PA if I'm at the screen, otherwise I'm happy to take what the market gives...
